## In-Class Agenda

- Review Init IS310 Homework Questions & GitHub or Git related questions
- Discuss assigned readings
- Complete introduction to File Formats. Slides available [here](../slides/04-version-file-histories.qmd) and lesson available [here](../materials/introducing-humanities-computing/06-intro-file-formats.qmd)
- Time permitting either discuss [Advanced Git & GitHub](../materials/introducing-humanities-computing/05-advanced-git-github.qmd) OR work in groups on [first project assignment](../assessments/03-semester-project.qmd#collective-individual-topic-selection).
